LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RavenDoll.label: [Raven] Doll Suit
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RavenDoll.description: A Raven doll suit for children to wear. When worn, it hides the appearance of native wings, but it does not affect takeoff, flight, or landing.
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RavenDollHead.label: [Raven] Doll Head
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_RavenDollHead.description: Matching children's headwear for the Raven doll suit. It hides hair and Raven ear feathers, but does not affect other physical abilities.
